title: Backend Developer
tagline: Build APIs, work with databases and ship tested services
description: Learn how the server side works: programming fundamentals, the Node.js runtime, Express for HTTP APIs, REST design, relational data with SQL, then authentication and automated testing so your services are safe to run in production.
audience: Developers who want to build APIs and server-side applications

stages.title: Programming fundamentals
stages.description: Variables, control flow, functions, data structures and error handling in JavaScript (or Python if you prefer).

stages.title: Node.js
stages.description: The runtime: modules, the event loop, files, streams and environment configuration.

stages.title: Express.js
stages.description: Routing, middleware, validation and error handling for HTTP services.

stages.title: REST API design
stages.description: Resources, verbs, status codes, pagination, versioning and documentation.

stages.title: SQL and relational data
stages.description: Schema design, joins, indexes and transactions with MySQL or PostgreSQL.

stages.title: Authentication and security
stages.description: Password hashing, sessions, JSON Web Tokens, OAuth basics and the OWASP Top 10.
stages.topicNote: Authentication is covered in the authentication lessons of the Express and REST API tutorials and in Cybersecurity Fundamentals; there is no stand-alone authentication tutorial.

stages.title: Testing services
stages.description: Unit tests, integration tests against a real database and API contract tests.

seo.title: Backend Developer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap through programming fundamentals, Node.js, Express, REST API design, SQL, authentication and testing for server-side developers.
